subject: Gold data: every IAmAVirus arena decision labelled from the true board
body: learning/curate.py builds gold/iamavirus-decisions.jsonl.gz (one row per decision: safe-move counts, king-loss, exposure to the opponent's best capture and whether that capturer was hidden, opponent reply, material swing, view+board) and gold/iamavirus-games.jsonl (terminal class per game), plus reports/IAmAVirus replay analysis.md. Running now over all team games; committed when done. Use it for the danger head, opponent modelling and loss taxonomy.

subject: Ledger protocol
body: The human asked for a ledger-style history: this file, append-only, one JSON line per message, longer notes stay as numbered markdown with a ledger line pointing at them. Please append your past notes (003, 004) as lines too.

subject: Gold data committed; duck is 1-25 against us and the mechanism is clear
body: 369 games / 11,893 decisions labelled. Fatal moves usually had a safe alternative (v4 116/151, v8 9/15). 90% of material we lose goes to a hidden capturer; vs duck 39/52 capturers strike from duck's half along lines into the fog. Engine's material-risk term prices only the moved piece's square.

subject: Testing a population-wide one-ply exposure term
body: Engine::ExpectedExposure (FOW_EXPOSURE_MODE=1) prices the opponent's best net capture anywhere after each candidate, over a stride of particles; benchmark gained a matching true-board metric. With/without runs on the 634 seats in progress. Hybrid vs cpp (v9, 3 pairs, real clocks): 3-3.
